name: Alquist Proft
description: Alquist Proft is a human detective of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations, a former Azorius asset whose magic recreates anything he has seen.

summary.text: Alquist Proft is a human detective of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations, a former Azorius asset whose magic recreates anything he has seen.

bio.text: Proft enters the crime scene at Karlov Manor, introduces himself as the great detective, and deduces that Zegana was posed so the guild seals form a pattern, then confronts Etrata as the Dimir agent.
After Etrata is taken into Azorius custody, he visits her cell, reasons that if she was mind-controlled she is no more culpable than a knife, swears to clear her name, and lets her slip out.
Etrata then leads him to her hideout, where he finds a yellow-gray powder and collects it as evidence, and she protects him from Massacre Girl and helps him find the real killer.
He and Etrata seek out his friend Kylox, who is abducted and then killed, and Proft concludes that people are being brainwashed into attacks.
In Golgari territory Izoni tells him the powder is biological but unknown on Ravnica, and he later tells Kaya the killers are controlled by an outside force.
He gathers the guild leaders and exposes Trostani as the mastermind, after which Oba admits she killed the guild leaders.
Proft then hires Etrata as his assistant, and the two confront Niv-Mizzet about the Omenpath Project and offer him their services.
Later he is among the team facing the door at the House, and his mind magic is part of the artificial Omenpath that brings the team out onto Ravnica.

status.text: As of the latest story, Proft is alive and back on Ravnica, where he closes the door and a door engraved with moths forms in his mental office.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft enters the crime scene and introduces himself as the great detective.
timeline.quote: I'm Alquist Proft.

timeline.summary: Proft deduces that Zegana was posed so the guild seals form a pattern.
timeline.quote: she has been arranged such that the sign of each guild is visible on the coats beneath her, and a pattern has been formed.

timeline.summary: Proft shows the pattern includes all ten seals and says a Dimir member is in attendance.
timeline.quote: You've also failed to spot the one member of House Dimir in attendance.

timeline.summary: Proft explains he spotted a guest avoiding Selesnya members while wearing Selesnya colors.
timeline.quote: I might not have seen her, had she not been taking such exquisite care to avoid interaction with members of the Selesnya Conclave.

timeline.summary: Proft confronts Etrata, who bares vampire fangs and flees toward the hedge maze.
timeline.quote: Charging straight for Proft, she knocked the investigator to the ground and began to cut a straight line through the crowd, heading for the hedge maze.

timeline.summary: Proft's magic transforms the courtyard into an Orzhov alley, slowing Etrata.
timeline.quote: the world abruptly inverted itself around her

timeline.summary: Proft explains that his magic recreates anything he has seen.
timeline.quote: I make what's in here become out there, and I can recreate anything I've ever seen

timeline.summary: Proft persuades Kellan not to fight the Azorius over the suspect.
timeline.quote: This is not the time to stand our ground

timeline.summary: Lavinia demands that the suspect be remanded to Azorius custody and Etrata is taken away.
timeline.quote: Remand the suspect to Azorius custody at once

timeline.summary: Proft visits Etrata in her isolated cell.
timeline.quote: Etrata's cell was the only one occupied in this block, leaving her entirely isolated, save for her guards

timeline.summary: Proft asks Etrata why she killed so publicly and how she fooled the verity circles.
timeline.quote: will you tell me why you chose to kill such a prominent target in such a public way?

timeline.summary: Etrata denies killing Zegana and says she does not remember it.
timeline.quote: If I killed her, I don't remember it.

timeline.summary: Proft reasons that if Etrata was mind-controlled she is no more culpable than a knife.
timeline.quote: if mind control or magic had been used to force Etrata's actions, she was no more culpable than a knife.

timeline.summary: Proft swears to clear Etrata's name, and she gives her word to help.
timeline.quote: I am Alquist Proft, and I will risk my name to clear yours.

timeline.summary: Proft unlocks Etrata's cell and tells her to meet him at his home.
timeline.quote: the lock on her cell sprang open with a click

timeline.summary: Etrata slips out into the shadows and Proft stages a scene over the empty cell.
timeline.quote: Etrata nodded before stepping out of the cell and melting into the shadows.

timeline.summary: Kaya pulls Kellan from an argument and he explains Etrata vanished from Azorius custody.
timeline.quote: Detective Proft went to speak with the prisoner in Azorius custody. When he got there, she was gone.

timeline.summary: Etrata leads Proft along a Dimir street and opens a concealed entrance to her hideout.
timeline.quote: With a weary grinding sound, a section of the wall slightly smaller than an ordinary door shifted and slid inward

timeline.summary: Etrata says she remembers nothing of the party or of getting ready for it.
timeline.quote: I don't remember going to that party, much less getting ready for it

timeline.summary: Proft explains he is helping her because her case is the most interesting puzzle since the invasion.
timeline.quote: Right now, you represent the most interesting puzzle set before me since the invasion.

timeline.summary: Proft finds a fine yellow-gray powder on Etrata's bedside table and pillow.
timeline.quote: There, dusted across the wood and onto the nearby pillowcase, was a fine yellowish-gray powder.

timeline.summary: Proft scrapes the powder into a jar for evidence.
timeline.quote: he scraped as much of it as he could into the open jar before sealing it firmly.

timeline.summary: Etrata decides to defend Proft against an attacker in the hall.
timeline.quote: With a frustrated sigh, Etrata turned, pulling two more knives from inside her shirt, and leapt for the fight behind her.

timeline.summary: A figure in red and black attacks Proft; Etrata knocks her away and recognizes Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: Proft was on the ground, a figure dressed in red and black crouching over him, a knife in either hand.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl reveals she was hired to kill the man who caught Etrata.
timeline.quote: I was supposed to kill the man who caught you.

timeline.summary: Etrata claims Proft and says they are finding out who really killed Zegana; Massacre Girl stands down.
timeline.quote: I'm helping him find out who really killed Zegana.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl leaves, promising there is always next time.
timeline.quote: There's always next time.

timeline.summary: Proft says he will take Etrata to an old friend not associated with the Agency.
timeline.quote: To see an old friend of mine

timeline.summary: Etrata pins Proft against a wall and demands to know where they are going.
timeline.quote: All will be clear right now, or we're not going any farther.

timeline.summary: Proft explains the powder needs analysis by someone trustworthy.
timeline.quote: The powder I found in your chamber is like nothing I've encountered before.

timeline.summary: They find Kylox's workshop door unlocked, which is unusual.
timeline.quote: That's unusual. He never leaves the door unlocked.

timeline.summary: The workshop is revealed to be destroyed as if by a gang.
timeline.quote: It looked as if an entire gang of people had passed through, smashing everything they could get their hands on.

timeline.summary: Proft's magic reconstructs the workshop to find what is out of place.
timeline.quote: The light pulsed, and the workshop was no longer destroyed.

timeline.summary: Etrata opens the hidden trapdoor by drumming a pattern.
timeline.quote: A square portion of floor dropped several inches with a loud click.

timeline.summary: They find Kylox writing furiously in a hidden chamber.
timeline.quote: was a red viashino, facial scales reflecting the pallid light of the lantern on the desk's edge.

timeline.summary: Kylox reveals he was working on something secret and will only tell Ezrim.
timeline.quote: Something no one was meant to know.

timeline.summary: Goblins chain and abduct Kylox as Proft and Etrata hide.
timeline.quote: The goblins produced thin lengths of mizzium chain, wrapping them around Kylox, who said nothing and only allowed himself to be taken.

timeline.summary: Proft takes a small wooden box from Kylox's shelf.
timeline.quote: he paused by the shelf Kylox had been next to, just long enough to grab a small, unornamented wooden box and tuck it under his arm.

timeline.summary: The goblin kidnappers carry Kylox to a pawnshop.
timeline.quote: the goblins carried Kylox to a disreputable-looking pawnshop.

timeline.summary: Etrata subdues Krenko's six guards.
timeline.quote: in moments, all six guards were on the ground, not moving.

timeline.summary: A drugged attacker crashes in, kills Kylox, and is subdued by Etrata.
timeline.quote: There was a strangled gasp as the viashino fell out of the way and slid, motionless, to the floor.

timeline.summary: Etrata breaks the attacker's fugue with her psychic gaze.
timeline.quote: he jerked back, pupils returning to a more normal state as he tried to recoil from her and the fear she had induced.

timeline.summary: Proft concludes that people are being brainwashed into attacks.
timeline.quote: People are being brainwashed into these attacks.

timeline.summary: Proft leads Etrata down into Golgari territory, explaining that Korozda's rise reshaped the warrens.
timeline.quote: When Korozda rose to the surface, it changed the shape of the warrens below.

timeline.summary: Proft and Etrata meet Izoni in the ruins of an old guildhall.
timeline.quote: I would never have found you if you hadn't allowed it, Izoni

timeline.summary: Izoni analyzes the powder and says it is natural and biological but unknown on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: This is natural. Biological, at the very least.

timeline.summary: Izoni says the Swarm hides because of something not of Ravnica, and Proft fears the invaders have changed tactics.
timeline.quote: We may not have won as decisively as we all want to believe.

timeline.summary: Proft chases a hooded figure and is struck unconscious.
timeline.quote: fell as something slammed into the side of his head with force enough to take the rest of the world away.

timeline.summary: In Proft's mind palace a hooded figure rifles through his files.
timeline.quote: A figure in a long, hooded cloak was rummaging through one of his drawers, looking at the files inside.

timeline.summary: The hooded figure says Ravnica is only a waypoint and takes a folder.
timeline.quote: Ravnica is a waypoint, not the destination.

timeline.summary: Etrata strikes Proft awake after he fell into a trance.
timeline.quote: I hit you when you wouldn't wake up

timeline.summary: Proft and Etrata reveal they summoned Kaya.
timeline.quote: It's fine, Etrata. We invited her.

timeline.summary: Proft tells Kaya the killers are controlled by an outside force.
timeline.quote: The killers are being controlled by an outside force.

timeline.summary: Kaya confesses she found a Phyrexian-script note on Teysa's body.
timeline.quote: A note, in her own hand, but not her own language. It was written in Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: Proft announces he knows who is responsible and asks Kaya to arrange a gathering.
timeline.quote: I know who's responsible for this

timeline.summary: Proft steps out of a shadow clapping, and Etrata reveals herself.
timeline.quote: Detective Proft stepping out of a shadow that couldn't possibly have concealed him for this long

timeline.summary: Proft argues the Guildpact exempts Etrata from consequences for her escape.
timeline.quote: I believe you'll find the Guildpact exempts her from any consequence for that action.

timeline.summary: Proft declares that the killer is in the room.
timeline.quote: our killer is here with us, in this very room.

timeline.summary: Proft takes Kaya aside and a strange white root grows from the wallpaper into a bruise-colored flower.
timeline.quote: The movement proved to be a white, wormlike root, uncurling from the pattern in the wallpaper, spiraling into a thicker base.

timeline.summary: Proft traps the flower in an evidence jar as it emits yellow-gray pollen.
timeline.quote: Proft clamped a clear glass evidence jar over the flower just as it began to emit a puff of yellow-gray dust.

timeline.summary: Proft sets the jar before the assembled leaders to begin his presentation.
timeline.quote: He held up his jar, turning so that everyone would have a chance to see

timeline.summary: Proft lists the victims and the attempt on Aurelia, noting the killers had no memory.
timeline.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine; Teysa of the Orzhov Syndicate; Kylox of the Izzet League.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that loss of memory is the connecting thread.
timeline.quote: The loss of memory is the connecting thread.

timeline.summary: Proft calls out Judith for trying to throw blame on Rakdos.
timeline.quote: You've been trying, desperately, to throw blame on your own parun at every step along the way.

timeline.summary: Proft recounts Izoni's analysis of the powder.
timeline.quote: Izoni of the Golgari examined it on my behalf

timeline.summary: Proft says the flower is not Phyrexian and that his announced interviews were a ruse to bait the killer.
timeline.quote: This flower is not Phyrexian in origin.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals the killer must be a member of the Selesnya Conclave.
timeline.quote: This is a creation of the Conclave. Our killer is a member of the Selesnya.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that Vitu-Ghazi's roots could deliver the flowers anywhere in the city.
timeline.quote: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi spread throughout the city.

timeline.summary: Trostani's three faces show conflicting reactions.
timeline.quote: She said nothing, only continued looking back, the expressions on her three faces completely out of alignment.

timeline.summary: Lavinia agrees Proft and Etrata committed no crime.
timeline.quote: It'll take months to clear the paperwork, and I'm not happy about it, but yes, we're agreed

timeline.summary: Proft dismisses Tolsimir's confession, noting he lacked the ability to create the plant.
timeline.quote: Noble of you to try to take the burden of blame onto yourself, but you didn't do this

timeline.summary: Proft names Trostani as the mastermind behind all the killings.
timeline.quote: Trostani did this, all of it. She's been behind it all along.

timeline.summary: The room is stunned by Proft's accusation that Trostani is the killer and Ezrim asks Kaya if she knew.
timeline.quote: Ezrim looked to Kaya.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir insists Trostani cannot have done it because she cannot leave the healing tree.
timeline.quote: she can't leave Vitu-Ghazi while the tree is healing!

timeline.summary: Proft argues that Ravnica has been blaming Phyrexia for crimes it was capable of itself.
timeline.quote: It's become easy, in the aftermath of war, to blame everything on the Phyrexians.

timeline.summary: Oba breaks her calm and admits she killed the guild leaders because they deserved it.
timeline.quote: Because they deserved it

timeline.summary: Oba says she has been killing for weeks and is not finished.
timeline.quote: I've been killing for weeks

timeline.summary: Oba shakes the room and knocks Aurelia and Proft down.
timeline.quote: The room shook, not hard, but hard enough to drop Aurelia back to her seat and Detective Proft to the floor.

timeline.summary: Kaya decides Oba must die and Proft kneels by Etrata.
timeline.quote: after what Oba had admitted, she'd known the dryad had to die.

timeline.summary: Kaya surveys the room: Krenko is almost absorbed into the wall and the guild leaders are entangled, including Ral, while Proft kneels by Etrata.
timeline.quote: The guild leaders had been entangled and subdued, even Ral

timeline.summary: Etrata reveals she was playing dead and proposes becoming Proft's assistant, as House Dimir is all but gone.
timeline.quote: If you take one of us home, you have to keep us.

timeline.summary: Kaya frees the guild leaders; Aurelia drags Krenko off to be arrested.
timeline.quote: all save Krenko, who found himself dragged along by a furious Aurelia determined to see someone arrested

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Kellan she is leaving in the morning to help Tyvar hunt a dire bear, and learns Judith is still missing and Proft has hired Etrata.
timeline.quote: I'm heading out in the morning,

timeline.summary: Proft and Etrata enter Niv-Mizzet's chamber for an appointment that was hard to obtain.
timeline.quote: Proft's footsteps echoed as he walked into the chamber currently occupied by Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind and Living Guildpact.

timeline.summary: Proft asks how Niv-Mizzet could fail to notice Trostani's use of Ravnica to kill, and the dragon says he was otherwise occupied.
timeline.quote: "I was otherwise occupied," said Niv-Mizzet, somewhat stiffly.

timeline.summary: Proft raises Kylox's project, and reasons that Niv-Mizzet stood back because he was working on something larger than a few murders.
timeline.quote: the only reason you would stand back was because you were working on something bigger.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals he decoded Kylox's cryptex and knows about the Omenpath Project.
timeline.quote: I know about the Omenpath Project.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that rifts called Omenpaths opened across the planes after the invasion, and Niv-Mizzet says they are natural to Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: A phenomenon natural to the plane of Kaldheim.

timeline.summary: Proft deduces that Niv-Mizzet plans to make Ravnica the hub of the connected Multiverse, and Niv-Mizzet confirms it.
timeline.quote: "Yes," said Niv-Mizzet simply.

timeline.summary: Proft offers his and Etrata's services to Niv-Mizzet, who is surprised and admits the deductive skills would be welcome.
timeline.quote: Your deductive skills would not be unwelcome,

timeline.summary: A month earlier, Jace baits and knocks down Proft on Ravnica to link minds with him.
timeline.quote: Jace turns, swings the pipe as best he can, and feels satisfying contact as he knocks Proft to the ground.

timeline.summary: Zimone reports that Nashi's drones recorded a house with distorted space on the other side.
timeline.quote: Just a house, perfectly normal, if in need of a good cleaning service.

timeline.summary: The door slams shut behind the team as Aminatou, Etrata, Proft and Niv-Mizzet watch.
timeline.quote: Then the door closed, and the House was all.

timeline.summary: Proft offers Kaito an idea to help rescue his friends.
timeline.quote: If you would come with me, I think I have an idea that might help us

timeline.summary: The team escapes through the door, with Kaito covering Tyvar against a nightmare.
timeline.quote: Together they ran for the door.

timeline.summary: Kaito explains the artificial Omenpath is made of his spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting and a piece of the House.
timeline.quote: My spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting, and a piece of the House that I took with me when I had to planeswalk away.

timeline.summary: The team steps out onto Ravnica.
timeline.quote: stepping with them out into the light of the Ravnican afternoon.

timeline.summary: Proft closes the door in a spray of moths of light.
timeline.quote: he made a sharp gesture and the door slammed shut, vanishing in a spray of white light shaped like tiny, glittering moths.

timeline.summary: A door engraved with moths forms in Proft's mental office.
timeline.quote: the shape of a doorframe slowly appearing out of the shelves and photographs.

relations.note: helps him find the real killer
relations.quote: I'm helping him find out who really killed Zegana.
Why am I trying so hard to keep you alive?
It's fine, Etrata. We invited her.
I committed no crimes in releasing her to assist me.

relations.note: has worked to keep him alive
relations.quote: after I've worked so hard to keep you alive

relations.note: Proft officially hired Etrata as his aide.
relations.quote: He officially hired Etrata as his aide,

relations.note: Etrata is supposed to keep Proft from dying.
relations.quote: Remember how I'm supposed to keep you from dying?

pages_say.description: A detective people have been talking about whom Zegana thinks Kellan might be.
A graying human detective in an azure coat who deduces the guild-seal pattern and exposes the Dimir agent; his magic recreates anything he has seen.
A former Azorius asset turned Agency detective who interviews Etrata and helps her escape.
An Agency detective some suspect of helping Etrata disappear.
An Agency detective who frees Etrata and investigates her missing time, discovering strange yellow-gray powder in her hideout.
An Agency detective whose magic recreates what he has seen, who seeks an analysis of the strange powder and rescues Kylox.
An Agency detective who takes Etrata to Golgari territory and ends the story claiming to know who is responsible.
An Agency detective who gathers the guild leaders and exposes the killer.
An Agency detective who accuses Trostani and draws out Oba's confession, then grieves Etrata.
A detective who tends the fallen Etrata and then hires her as his assistant.
A detective who confronts Niv-Mizzet about the Omenpath Project and offers him his services.
A Ravnican detective Jace studies for his ability to project psychic imprints.
A scoffing man in a long brown coat who is among the researchers studying the door.
A researcher who has an idea to help Kaito.
A researcher whose mind magic holds the artificial Omenpath open and who is visited by a door at the end.
